# Lyorune

> Lyorune is a free healing frames addon (raid frames with click casting) for World of Warcraft: Forever, the official Blizzard game (interface 16001). Made by BellaDroode. Available in French and English. Current version: __VERSION__.

Lyorune shows the whole group or raid as frames and casts the healer's spells with one click on a player's frame. It is designed to be simple, light in combat (events per unit, no permanent loop) and pleasant to look at. It suits every healer class on WoW Forever: priest, druid, paladin and shaman. It never changes the game's frames or other addons' frames, so it runs alongside ElvUI, Clique and other interface addons. No dependency.

Main features:
- Click casting: every mouse button, alone or with Shift, Ctrl, Alt, casts a chosen spell on a player's frame; a trinket can go with the spell.
- Hover keys: a keyboard key, extra mouse button or wheel casts a spell on the hovered frame.
- Everything at a glance: health, incoming heals, shields, heal absorbs, mana, other healers' low mana, heals over time and debuffs (drawn by the game, visible in combat), boss private auras, players' big defensives, stunned, feared or polymorphed players, threat, range in three levels, global cooldown, casting bar or ring.
- Dispels: the frame lights up for magic, curse, disease or poison.
- Resurrection on the same click on a dead player.
- Missing buffs panel out of combat.
- Game key bindings (AddOns section): open the options, show or hide the frames, cast the next missing buff, test mode.
- Low mana announcement that still works when WoW Forever hides mana from addons.
- Five themes, high contrast, sorting by group or role, separate tank and pet frames, pinned players.
- Profiles per group size, battleground, arena and specialization, applied automatically; partial copy; sharing by code or in game.
- Test mode with a fake group of 5 to 40 players; built-in one-minute tutorial.
- Options window in eleven chapters: a preview cell shows every setting live, a golden rune marks changed settings (one click resets them), and a search finds any setting.

Keywords: World of Warcraft, World of Warcraft: Forever, WoW Forever, WoW addon, Blizzard, MMORPG, healing frames, raid frames, party frames, click casting, healer addon, dungeon, raid, PvP, battleground, arena, alternative to VuhDo, HealBot, Grid and Cell.

Installation: download the archive from GitHub Releases, unzip it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`, start the game. Main command: `/lyorune`.

License: all rights reserved, free to use and share unchanged. GitHub Releases is the only official source.

## En français

Lyorune est un addon gratuit de cadres de soin pour World of Warcraft: Forever : soin d'un clic, touches au survol, dissipation, soins entrants, portée, buffs manquants, annonce de mana faible même quand la mana est cachée, profils, thèmes et partage. Pour le prêtre, le druide, le paladin et le chaman. Auteur : BellaDroode.
